description: Defines classes, enums, and structures for managing haptic generator effects, including context management, parameters, and processing chains within the Android audio effect framework.

classes.name: HapticGeneratorContext
classes.description: Manages the state and processing of haptic effects, including configuration, parameter management, and effect processing chain.

methods.name: HapticGeneratorContext::reset
methods.description: Resets the haptic generator state and parameters.

methods.name: HapticGeneratorContext::setHgHapticScales
methods.description: Sets the haptic scales for the generator.

methods.name: HapticGeneratorContext::setHgVibratorInformation
methods.description: Sets the vibrator information used for haptic generation.

methods.name: HapticGeneratorContext::lvmProcess
methods.description: Processes input audio data to generate haptic feedback, returning status.
